    Fit function used by the meta_linear() engines

    Source: R/parsnip-models.R
    meta_linear_fit.Rd

    meta_linear_fit() is called by parsnip to fit meta_linear() models. It is exported so parsnip can find it; most users will not call it directly.

    Usage

    meta_linear_fit(
  formula,
  data,
  weights = NULL,
  method = "REML",
  test = "z",
  level = 0.95
)

    Arguments

    formula

    A model formula with the effect size on the left.

    data

    The training data.

    weights

    Inverse variance case weights. When NULL, the .vi column of data is used.

    method

    The estimator passed to meta_regress().

    test

    "z" or "hksj".

    level

    Confidence level.

    Value

    A <meta_fit>.

    Examples

    bcg <- meta_effect_size(bcg_trials, "RR",
  event1 = tpos, n1 = tpos + tneg, event2 = cpos, n2 = cpos + cneg
)
meta_linear_fit(.yi ~ ablat, data = bcg, weights = 1 / bcg$.vi)
#> # Meta-regression <meta_fit>
#> # Model: random effects, restricted maximum likelihood
#> # Measure: generic effect size; k = 13
#> # tau^2 = 0.0763; I^2 = 68.39%; H^2 = 3.16
#> # Q(11) = 30.73, p = 0.0012
#> # A tibble: 2 × 7
#>   term        estimate std.error statistic   p.value conf.low conf.high
#>   <chr>          <dbl>     <dbl>     <dbl>     <dbl>    <dbl>     <dbl>
#> 1 (Intercept)   0.251    0.249        1.01 0.313      -0.237     0.740 
#> 2 ablat        -0.0291   0.00720     -4.04 0.0000524  -0.0432   -0.0150
